hero.title: Customers, hours and invoices. On your terms.
hero.subtitle: Haij is an open source business platform for solo consultants and micro-businesses. Danish-first, hosted in the EU, and built so you can take all of your data with you the day you want to.
hero.trust: Open source · AGPL-3.0 · Data in the EU

values.danishBody: CVR lookups, Danish invoicing rules and VAT are the starting point, not an adaptation. The platform speaks Danish because your business does.
values.dataBody: Everything runs on EU-owned infrastructure, and you can export your entire organization at any time. No lock-in, no fine print.
values.securityBody: Passkeys and two-factor authentication from day one, tenant isolation enforced in the database itself, and every change in an audit trail.

landing.status: In open development. The foundation is in place; CRM and time tracking are the next modules.
